docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:63:## §2 Theory Framework — Mechanism Activation + Phantom Space Boundary (大重写 2026-05-01)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:64:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:65:> **Cross-reference (added 2026-05-04)**: §2 是 **mechanism explanation layer** (Zoom 1-4 解释假说); 跟 §21 **intervention taxonomy** (3-spectrum × 3-layer) 是 orthogonal 维度。**§2 关心 phantom routing space 内部 mechanism** (M1/M2 axis activation, etc.); **§21 关心 substitution gradient 上 paper-1 跟 industry precedents 的 substrate 站位** (NLWeb / OmniParser-v2 / Magma / ScribeAgent / AppAgent-v2 / UI-TARS vs phantom routing). 两个 view 互补不替代。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:66:>
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:67:> **Conceptual structure 严格 2 层分离** (笔记 §108 evidence/explanation separation):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:68:> - **Explanation layer** (因果假说, §2 主住所): Zoom 1 architectural / Zoom 2 axis behavioral / Zoom 3 named phenomena / Zoom 4 model-internal
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:69:> - **Evidence layer** (观测数据, §3 主住所): Outcome / Macro / Micro / Efficiency × cross-task / mode / site / model
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:70:> - 两层不混 — paper writing 时 reviewer 最忌 evidence-as-explanation
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:71:>
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:72:> **Retract list (历史 framing 已 retract, 不要再用)**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:73:> - ❌ "5-mode 沿 cube 对角路径" + "4 mismatched 排除 (mismatched parsing tax)" 论证 (§108.2)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:74:> - ❌ 8-corner 2x2x2 cube factorial design 作 paper §2 axis (§108.3)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:75:> - ❌ 6-corner asymmetric grid (a/b × c/¬c × 1/2) (§108.3)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:76:> - ❌ (a)(c) prompt decomposition 作 axis (改用 mechanism activation, §108.3)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:77:> - ❌ "Three-layer mechanism argument" (Layer 1/2/3) 命名 — 改用 evidence/explanation 双层 + Zoom 1-4 (§108.6)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:78:> - ❌ "Approach 1 vs Approach 2" dichotomy — Approach 2 = Zoom 1, Approach 1 不是 single thing (§108.6)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:79:> - ❌ "3rd mechanism (coherence)" 候选升 §2 — 应在 §3 Micro dim 内分析 (§108.4)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:80:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:81:### Zoom 1 (architectural): Phantom space boundary + 2-axis activation by design
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:82:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:83:**Phantom routing space** = subset of 3-axis modal cube characterized by **"skip annotated image"** boundary (axis 3 = no image)。Cube 有 8 corners (3 axes: text payload × system prompt × image)；paper 测 **4 phantom corners (cube image-off 半) + 1 image-on cube endpoint + 1 image-only mode (Vision, cube 之外)** = **5 cube modes + 1 image-only mode = 6 paper modes**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:84:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:85:**Phantom routing space** = subset of 2×2×2 modal cube characterized by **"skip annotated image"** boundary。Cube 有 8 corners (3 axes: text payload × system prompt × image)；paper 测 **4 phantom corners (cube image-off 半) + 1 image-on cube endpoint + 1 image-only mode (Vision, cube 之外)** = **5 cube modes + 1 image-only mode = 6 paper modes**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:86:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:87:| # | text | prompt | image | mode | 在 phantom space? |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:88:|---|---|---|---|---|---|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:89:| 1 | AXTree | DOM-prompt | No | **DOM** | ✅ phantom corner (origin baseline) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:90:| 2 | AXTree | DOM-prompt | Yes | "DOM+image" | ❌ violates boundary (image embedding tax) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:91:| 3 | AXTree | SoM-prompt | No | **P-prompt** | ✅ phantom corner (axis 2 alone @ AXTree 锚点) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:92:| 4 | AXTree | SoM-prompt | Yes | (mismatched + image) | ❌ violates boundary |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:93:| 5 | [SOM_MARKS] | DOM-prompt | No | **P-text** | ✅ phantom corner (axis 1 alone @ DOM-prompt 锚点) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:94:| 6 | [SOM_MARKS] | DOM-prompt | Yes | "P-text+image" | ❌ violates boundary |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:95:| 7 | [SOM_MARKS] | SoM-prompt | No | **P-SoM** | ✅ phantom corner (cube center, axis 1+2 compound) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:96:| 8 | [SOM_MARKS] | SoM-prompt | Yes | **SoM** | image-on cube endpoint (paper baseline, NOT phantom) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:97:| — | none | — | Yes | **Vision** | image-only mode (cube 之外, axis 1 = "no text") |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:98:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:99:**Boundary 定义性属性 (axis 3 = "no annotated image")**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:100:- 4 phantom corners 都 share 4-fold drop-in by construction:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:101:  - (a) cost ≈ DOM — no image embedding tax (`[SOM_MARKS]` 是 AXTree regex filter，~3K text both)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:102:  - (b) latency ~50% lower — no image inference stage
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:103:  - (c) signal AUROC ≥ baseline — emergent (5/5 phantom `overall_usable=True`，red P-text 0.793 = 5-mode max)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:104:  - (d) drop-one oracle 1.7-3.8pp positive per arm — emergent (B0 red: P-text +3.81 / P-SoM +3.33 / P-prompt +2.86，all sig CI excludes 0)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:105:- (a)(b) 由 boundary derive (definitional)；(c)(d) 是经验验证的 emergent property —— **definition-then-validation 双层结构**
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:106:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:107:**Why exclude #2/#4/#6 (3 image-on phantom corners)**: 一旦加 annotated image 回去，cost / latency / carbon 都跟 SoM 拉齐 → 失去 4-fold drop-in property → 不再属于 phantom space。这 3 个 corners 在 routing 维度上是 SoM 的 variants (image cost dominate)，不提供 phantom-class deployment value。即 **boundary 是 "no annotated image"，不是 "matched parsing"**。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:108:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:109:**Why P-prompt (#3) 不是 mismatched-redundant** (针对旧 framing 的修正):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:110:- 旧 framing 担心 SoM-prompt + AXTree text "mismatched parsing" 必死 → 实证 falsified
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:111:- P-prompt 有真 LLM 机制 (axis 2 effect alone)：**visual prompting without image** —— SoM-style prompt 即使无图仍 activate agent 的 visual-mark referencing parsing，agent 在 AXTree 上自动 fallback 到 element_id 引用，仍 recover 部分 visual 结构信息。**Lit anchor stack** (3 互补 mechanism): (a) **Mirage Effect** Asadi et al. 2026 (arXiv:2603.21687, Stanford) — VLM 无图准确率达有图的 ~70-80% (实验笔记 §18); (b) **Scaffold Effect** Vu & Balloccu 2026 — prompt 仅提及 modality 可用就解释 70-80% performance shift independent of image presence (实验笔记 §25 + phantom_som.md §3.5); (c) **Cross-modal flow** Kaduri et al. — middle-layer cross-modal flows store image info in query tokens enabling image-consistent generation without direct image-token attention (phantom_som.md §2.1)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:112:- 实测 anchor: B0 red P-prompt 4-mode drop-one **+2.86pp [0.95, 5.24] sig** 验证 axis 2 alone 在 AXTree 锚点下有 routing value
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:113:- 6-mode oracle vs 5-mode +1.90pp [0.48, 3.81] sig 验证 P-prompt 贡献 incremental unique tasks (6 tasks added, 1 unique to P-prompt)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:114:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:115:**Phantom space 内部结构 (4 corners 形成 2×2 ablation diamond)**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:116:- DOM ↔ P-text: axis 1 alone (DOM-prompt 锚点)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:117:- P-prompt ↔ P-SoM: axis 1 alone (SoM-prompt 锚点) — **双锚点验证 axis 1 effect prompt-anchor-invariant**
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:118:- DOM ↔ P-prompt: axis 2 alone (AXTree 锚点)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:119:- P-text ↔ P-SoM: axis 2 alone ([SOM_MARKS] 锚点) — **双锚点验证 axis 2 effect text-anchor-invariant**
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:120:- DOM ↔ P-SoM: axis 1 + axis 2 compound (cube diagonal, paper-headline P-SoM 在此)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:121:- P-SoM = cube center, axis 1 + axis 2 compound, paper-headline representative arm
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:122:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:123:**Image-on extension (cube #8) + image-only (Vision)**: SoM 是 phantom space 之外的 image-on baseline，paper 用作 axis 3 primary endpoint (与 phantom space 任一 corner 对比 isolate axis 3 effect)。Vision 是 cube 之外的 image-only mode (axis 1 = "no text")，paper 用作 image-only routing arm baseline。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:124:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:125:**Cascade interpretation (§1 cascade 与 phantom space 的关系)**: §1 cascade `DOM → P-text → P-SoM → SoM` 是 phantom space 内一条 token-monotonic path (axis 1 → axis 2) + 出 phantom space 到 SoM 的 axis 3 跃迁。P-prompt 是 phantom space 第 4 corner，闭合 2×2 ablation diamond，验证 axis 1/2 effect 在双锚点下 invariant。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:126:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:127:Paper Section 3 footnote 用此 defense reviewer "why 5+1 not 8" + "why is P-prompt not mismatched-redundant"。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:128:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:129:### Zoom 1 (architectural completeness): Approach 2 deductive argument
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:130:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:131:**Paper §2 framework completeness 不依赖 finite data verification, 而是 architectural deductive argument**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:132:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:133:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:134:PREMISE 1: Phantom space comparison 锁 image=✗ (axis 3 fixed)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:135:PREMISE 2: Agent's input 只剩 (prompt 文本) + (obs 文本) 两个 component
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:136:PREMISE 3: 4 phantom corners 仅 vary 这两个 input component:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:137:            corner ∈ {(b,1)=DOM, (b,2)=P-text, (a-with-c,1)=P-prompt, (a-with-c,2)=P-SoM}
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:138:PREMISE 4: LLM 是 deterministic forward function on input tokens
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:139:            (T=0 + greedy decoding 假设, Phase A 后真; 但 B0 proxy 仅 decision-level
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:140:             convergent, 见 §107.1)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:141:CONCLUSION: 任何 differential 机制 必由 input 差异 trigger
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:142:            → 必 attributable to (prompt change) 或 (text change) 或两者
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:143:            → M1 (prompt-axis activation) 和 M2 (text-axis activation) 是 exhaustive
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:144:            → phantom space 内**没有 hidden 3rd axis** (by construction)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:145:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:146:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:147:**关键性质**: 这是 **deductive argument**, 不是 inductive evidence。即使以后跑 100 个 phantom corners, 也不能反驳 — 因为只要 phantom corners 仍只 vary 这两个 input dimension, M1+M2 仍是 exhaustive。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:148:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:149:**Caveat**: Architectural argument 给 axis-level 完备性, 不给 axis 内部 sub-mechanism 完备性 (M1 内部是 Mirage Effect / Scaffold Effect / Cross-modal flow 哪个 dominate 仍需 lit + empirical 区分 — 这归属 Zoom 2/3/4)。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:150:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:151:### Zoom 2 (behavioral): M1/M2 mechanism activation 2x2 framework
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:152:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:153:**Insight (§108.4)**: prompt 文本 coupling ≠ mechanism activation coupling。LLM internal state 层有两个 orthogonal axes:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:154:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:155:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:156:Axis M1 (Image-mirage activation):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:157:  触发条件: prompt 期待 image (SoM-style guidance 自带 image expectation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:158:  LLM 内部状态: vision-grounded attention pattern 启动, visual tokens 缺席,
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:159:              language prior 填补缺席视觉 (Mirage / Scaffold / Cross-modal flow)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:160:  
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:161:Axis M2 (Flat-list activation):  
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:162:  触发条件: obs text 是 flat indexed list ([SOM_MARKS])
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:163:  LLM 内部状态: hierarchical tree-traversal exploration policy 切换到 
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:164:               sequential list-scanning policy
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:165:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:166:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:167:**4 phantom corners = 2x2 activation pattern**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:168:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:169:| Mode | Axis M1 | Axis M2 | LLM internal state |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:170:|---|:---:|:---:|---|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:171:| DOM | ❌ | ❌ | origin baseline |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:172:| P-text | ❌ | ✅ | M2 alone (Format-swap subspace) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:173:| P-prompt | ✅ | ❌ | M1 alone (Mirage subspace) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:174:| P-SoM | ✅ | ✅ | M1 ⊕ M2 compound (cube center, paper hero) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:175:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:176:**P-SoM 是 cube center 的 mechanistic 理由**: 唯一同时 activate M1 + M2 + 它们 nonlinear interaction 的 corner。Compound state ≠ 简单叠加 (transformer attention nonlinear combination), P-SoM unique tasks (3 tasks B0 reddit, 既不在 P-text 也不在 P-prompt) 是 emergent capability。这给 P-SoM 是 paper hero 一个 mechanistic 理由 (不只是几何 cube center)。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:177:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:178:### Zoom 2.5 (reverse explanation, NEW 2026-05-01 evening): 别扭 framework + Capability-modulated effect
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:179:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:180:> **⏸️ Provisional**: 现有数据 N=4 cells (B0 cls/red 含 phantom + B1 cls 5-mode + B1 red 3-mode), 全部 Phase A bug fix 之前 (commit `3c15cd7` 之前). 16-cell rerun 后 statistical commit, 现 framework 标 "provisional pending 16-cell rerun + cross-VLM-family validation"。详 笔记 §108.16。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:181:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:182:**Insight**: M1/M2 framework 是 **forward causal upstream** ("what input change happens"). 别扭 framework 是 **reverse causal downstream** ("what gap between expectation and reality"). 两者描述同一现象的不同 layer, 但 别扭 在 phantom space 内提供更 mechanism-aligned 解释。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:183:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:184:**别扭 2×2 grid (跟 forward 2×2 isomorphic 但 axis 不同)**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:185:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:186:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:187:                    No image 别扭         Image 别扭
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:188:                    ────────────────      ────────────────
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:189:No text 别扭        DOM (origin, 0)       P-SoM (axis B only, 1)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:190:                    SoM (image-on)        
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:191:                    
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:192:Text 别扭           P-text (axis A only,1) P-prompt (compound A+B, 2)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:193:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:194:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:195:| Mode | Text 别扭 | Image 别扭 | # mismatch |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:196:|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:197:| DOM | ❌ | ❌ | 0 (origin baseline) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:198:| P-text | ✅ (DOM-prompt 期 AXTree, 给 [SOM_MARKS]) | ❌ | 1 |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:199:| P-prompt | ✅ (SoM-prompt 期 [SOM_MARKS], 给 AXTree) | ✅ (SoM 期 image, 无) | 2 (compound) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:200:| P-SoM | ❌ ([SOM_MARKS] match SoM-prompt) | ✅ (SoM 期 image, 无) | 1 |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:201:| SoM (image-on) | ❌ | ❌ | 0 |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:202:| Vision | n/a | n/a | n/a |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:203:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:204:**Per-axis mechanism (跟 Zoom 3 lit anchor 直接对接)**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:205:- **Text-轴 别扭** (axis A): prompt expects format X, obs gives format Y → format-translation fallback → **Sclar 2024 prompt-format sensitivity / Mishra 2022** lit anchor
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:206:- **Image-轴 别扭** (axis B): prompt expects image, none provided → language-prior visual completion → **Mirage Effect Asadi 2026 / Scaffold Effect Vu Balloccu 2026 / Cross-modal flow Kaduri** lit anchor
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:207:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:208:**4 distinguishing predictions** (vs forward M1/M2):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:209:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:210:| Prediction | Forward (M1/M2 activation) | Reverse (别扭) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:211:|---|---|---|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:212:| 1. Drop-one ranking | P-SoM (compound) > P-text ≈ P-prompt | P-text ≈ P-SoM (1 别扭) > P-prompt (2 别扭) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:213:| 2. Compound aggregate effect | predicted positive (more activation = better) | predicted **negative** (compound disruption hurts) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:214:| 3. FP rate | not predicted | image-轴 别扭 → cautious commit → low FP |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:215:| 4. Single 别扭 vs DOM aggregate | (forward predicts ≥) | predicted ≥ DOM (positive aggregate) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:216:

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:218:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:219:| Prediction | B0 reddit | B0 cls | B1 cls | B1 red |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:220:|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:221:| 1. P-prompt drop-one lowest | ✅ 2.86 < 3.81/3.33 | (P-prompt pending) | (P-prompt pending) | n/a |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:222:| 2. P-prompt raw SR < DOM | ✅ 10.48 < 11.43 | (pending) | (pending) | n/a |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:223:| 3. Image-轴 别扭 → low FP | ✅ P-SoM 0.48 lowest | 🟡 P-SoM 1.28 < P-text 2.14 | 🟡 P-SoM 2.56 = DOM | n/a |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:224:| 4. Single 别扭 ≥ DOM | ✅ both > DOM | ✅ both > DOM | ❌ **REVERSED** (P-text/P-SoM both < DOM) | n/a |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:225:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:226:→ **B0 cells: 4/4 别扭 predictions confirmed**. **B1 cls: prediction 4 reversed**.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:227:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:228:**Capability-modulated discovery (paper §7 finding)**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:229:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:230:Drop-one ranking 跨 capability 反转:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:231:- B0 reddit: P-text 3.81 > P-SoM 3.33 (text-axis > image-axis)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:232:- B0 cls: P-text 3.42 > P-SoM 2.56 (text-axis > image-axis)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:233:- **B1 cls: P-text 0.85 < P-SoM 1.71** (image-axis > text-axis, REVERSED)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:234:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:235:**Resolution: 别扭 + Lazy Minimization Hypothesis 联合**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:236:- 大 VLM (B0 235B-A22B): capability 充分 → text-format mismatch fallback effective → P-text drop-one 高
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:237:- 小 VLM (B1 4B): 视觉处理性价比差 → text-over-vision bias 强 → 优先 numeric label / 结构化 token. P-text 上 DOM-prompt vs [SOM_MARKS] obs format mismatch 让小 VLM confused (no capability for fallback). P-SoM 上 SoM-prompt + [SOM_MARKS] obs internally consistent + 仅 image 别扭 — 小 VLM thrives (依赖 numeric label, image absence less cognitive load).
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:238:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:239:→ **Capability-modulated 别扭 effect**: 小 VLM 偏好 image-轴 别扭, 大 VLM 偏好 text-轴 别扭。Paper §7 cross-capability 章节直接 cite。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:240:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:241:**对 paper sections 的 implication**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:242:- §1 hook drop-one "1.7-3.8pp per arm" 加 capability-modulated caveat ("magnitude 4× weaker on small VLM, direction reverses text-vs-image axis preference")
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:243:- §2 Theory: forward (M1/M2) + reverse (别扭) **layered framework** — forward describes design + measurement, reverse describes mechanism + interpretation
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:244:- §5 mechanism prose 用 别扭 narrative ("compound mismatch overload" / "image-axis fallback via language priors")
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:245:- §7 cross-capability 章节 直接受益 (capability-modulated reversal 是 paper §7 真实证 finding, 解锁 §7 prose ~40% → ~70% completion path)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:246:

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:248:- N=4 cells, 1 cell (B0 reddit) full 6-mode, 其他 partial
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:249:- Phase A bug pre-fix data — cycle false positives / dispatch noise affect aggregate metrics

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:253:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:254:### Zoom 3 (named phenomena): Lit-anchored mechanism phenomena
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:255:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:256:**M1 axis (Image-mirage) Zoom 3 lit anchors** (cross-model behavioral evidence):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:257:- **Mirage Effect** (Asadi et al. 2026, arXiv:2603.21687, Stanford): VLM 无图时仍自信描述视觉特征, **无图准确率达有图的 70-80%** (mirage-mode > guess-mode). 实验笔记 §18 line 457
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:258:- **Scaffold Effect** (Vu & Balloccu 2026): prompt 仅提及 modality 可用就解释 **70-80% 性能变化** independent of image presence. 临床 VLM 起源, web agent 同样适用. 实验笔记 §25 + phantom_som.md line 281
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:259:- **Cross-modal flow** (Kaduri et al.): middle-layer cross-modal flows store image info in query tokens, allowing image-consistent generation without direct image-token attention (phantom_som.md §2.1 line 83-89) — actually 这个偏 Zoom 4 mechanism
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:260:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:261:**M2 axis (Flat-list) Zoom 3 lit anchors**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:262:- **Prompt-format sensitivity** (Sclar 2024 / Mishra 2022): LLMs 对 spurious formatting features 极度敏感, minor prompt changes → major performance shifts
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:263:- **Tree-traversal vs list-scanning** (你 deep research SoM novelty doc line 84): "AXTree induces tree traversal trajectory (logical deduction over hierarchy) vs flat SoM induces sequential list scanning trajectory (rapid spatial approximation)"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:264:- Paper draft `section2_background.md` line 27 已 adopt: "the flat marks list tends to shift exploration toward quick element selection, AXTree hierarchy supports sustained navigation and search"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:265:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:266:### Zoom 3 expansion (5/6 Gemini DR returns 2026-05-01, Q5 pending)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:267:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:268:**Q1 Mirage / visual prompting w/o image — additional cross-model anchors** (`docs/literature/5.1/Cost-Aware Routing...md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:269:- **Wang et al. 2025 XLRS-Bench** (CVPR 2025, arXiv:2503.23771): text-only Qwen3-8B 51.6% **>** multimodal GPT-4o 45.2% on aggregate visual remote-sensing tasks — text-only **beats** multimodal in some visual-heavy domains
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:270:- **Liu et al. 2025 Plan-and-Act** (ICML 2025): 81.36% text-only SR on WebVoyager, 57.58% on WebArena-Lite — text-only SOTA via two-tier planner-executor architecture
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:271:- **Lù et al. 2025 AgentRewardBench** (arXiv:2604.04399): "**distraction phenomenon**" — incorporating both text + image observations *degrades* PRM performance vs text-only inputs (image introduces high-dimensional noise on text-defined semantic boundaries)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:272:- **Koh et al. 2024 VWA empirical**: GPT-4 text-only 7.25% vs GPT-4V multimodal 16.37% = **44% relative retention** (more conservative than Asadi 70-80% on real web tasks vs synthetic mirage benchmarks)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:273:- **Cross-VLM-family confirmed**: GPT-4V/4o (XLRS-Bench, ViLP) + Claude 3 (cross-modal flow) + Gemini 1.5 Pro (WebNavigator 72.9% multi-site) + Qwen-VL/LLaVA/InternVL (text-inertia + Mirage) — all exhibit Mirage Effect, validating cross-architecture generalization
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:274:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:275:**Q2 system prompt format (multi-step agent)** (`docs/literature/5.1/Sensitivity of LLM Agents...md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:276:- **Multi-step compounding finding**: format-induced loop rates compound exponentially over multi-step trajectories (single-turn lit understates effect)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:277:- **Surprise**: "**Text-based DOM-element referencing consistently outperforms Set-of-Mark visual bounding boxes** for prompt referencing due to alignment with textual pre-training" — relevant to paper §2 axis 2 framing (need careful prose distinction, see counter-evidence)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:278:- **Structured hallucination**: forced JSON output induces structured hallucinations + cycle increase, particularly on smaller models (Llama-3-8B)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:279:- **CoT trade-off**: Chain-of-Thought helps single-screen reasoning, **hurts** complex compositional sequences (catastrophic trajectory degradation when agents skip intermediary steps)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:280:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:281:**Q3 AXTree vs flat list — head-to-head + SoM-text isolation gap** (`docs/literature/5.1/Empirical Analysis of Observation Modalities...md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:282:- ✅ **Paper §1 first-work claim VERIFIED**: "**no study isolates SoM-style flat text as a standalone observation without its accompanying marked screenshot. The target paper fills this unprecedented gap**" — Phantom-SoM "first systematic SoM-text isolation" claim is lit-verified novel
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:283:- **Kerboua et al. 2025 FOCUSAGENT** (arXiv:2510.16252): AXTree pruning achieves task-success comparable to full AXTree at significantly reduced token count, but does NOT compare to flat lists
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:284:- **Tan et al. 2026 HMT** (arXiv:2603.07024): hierarchical 84.2% recall vs flat 65.8% — applied to **memory architecture** not direct observation, suggests structural format trade-off is task-dependent
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:285:- Forward citation: Yang 2023 SoM original paper has near-zero work isolating text from image — reaffirms gap
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:286:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:287:**Q4 Scaffold Effect cross-domain** (`docs/literature/5.1/Modality Collapse...md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:288:- ✅ **No fundamental counter-evidence**: "A comprehensive review of the 2023-2026 literature yields **no fundamental counter-evidence** directly contradicting the core premise of the Scaffold Effect"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:289:- Scaffold + Mirage + Text Inertia identified as 3 manifestations of same underlying "modality collapse" phenomenon
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:290:- DPO mitigation contestably fails ("collapsing multi-modal accuracy to random baselines rather than establishing genuine visual grounding")
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:291:- → Paper §5 axis 2 Mirage subspace anchored robustly; reviewer attack "Vu & Balloccu only clinical" preempted
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:292:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:293:**Q6 Lazy Minimization Hypothesis cross-VLM scaling** (`docs/literature/5.1/Examining the Lazy Minimization Hypothesis...md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:294:- **Scaling Law of Redundancy**: large VLMs robust to image-token pruning (Qwen-32B MMLU 80.81 → 80.01 under 80% retention pruning); small VLMs collapse harder
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:295:- **Pre-training mixture**: Qwen2-VL-7B BUTTERFLY ablation — text-only fine-tuning **slightly outperforms** image-text training (50.50% vs 50.00%) for complex conceptual learning — text provides cleaner gradient signals
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:296:- **Idefics2 8B**: trained on OBELICS (350M images / 115B text tokens), text:image ratio fundamentally conditions transformer to prioritize text representations
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:297:- **VILA**: re-blends text-only instruction data alongside image-text data during fine-tuning to remedy text-task degradation, inadvertently boosting text inertia
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:298:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:299:**Q5 Bidirectional modality fusion (Gemini DR 6/6 returned 2026-05-01 evening)** (`docs/literature/5.1/Vision-Language Model Modality Interaction A Comprehensive Analysis of Bidirectional Dominance and Failure Modes.md`):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:300:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:301:⭐⭐ **Paper §2 Axis 3 lit anchor 厚度终于到了** — 之前 axis 3 只有单点 anchor (Tong 2024 / Li POPE / Bitton-Guetta)，Q5 给 cross-benchmark 综合 + bidirectional framing 学术名词。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:302:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:303:- **Bidirectional Failure framing 是 "Novel synthesis"** (Q5 doc 自己 line 22 标注): "framing VLM modality interaction as exhibiting **dual failure modes that act in opposite directions** constitutes a novel theoretical synthesis. The current 2023-2026 literature largely treats these failure modes in isolation." → Paper §5 axis 3 prose 可 cite Q5 综述 + claim "first systematic web-agent multi-step application"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:304:- **Dual-axis same-paper benchmarks** (验证 axis 3 bidirectional framing 不是 paper artifact):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:305:  - **Guan et al. 2024 HallusionBench** (CVPR, arXiv:2310.14566): 单 benchmark 同时测 "visual illusion" (image-over-text) + "language hallucination" (text-over-vision). GPT-4V 31.42% / 其他开源 <16% on dual-axis control pairs
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:306:  - **Sun 2023 MMHal-Bench**: 8 distinct error categories, both visually-grounded failures + language-driven hallucinations on same model
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:307:- **Per-axis benchmark mapping** (paper §5 prose anchor):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:308:  - **Image-over-text** (M1 visual saliency hijack): Li et al. 2023 POPE (EMNLP, arXiv:2305.10355) — co-occurrence triggers false positives; CHAIR — autoregressive text fills visual gaps
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:309:  - **Text-over-vision** (M2 language prior override): Tong et al. 2024 "Eyes Wide Shut" (CVPR); Fu et al. 2024 BLINK (ECCV, arXiv:2404.12390) — perception primitives at 24-30% near random; Bitton-Guetta et al. 2023 WHOOPS! (ICCV); MM-Vet — OCR/spatial trigger text fallback
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:310:- **Scaling law on bidirectional bias** (paper §7 cross-capability anchor):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:311:  - **Large LLM (70B+) + compressed vision** → text-over-vision (parametric memory dominates sparse visual tokens)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:312:  - **Small LLM (7B) + uncompressed dense vision** → image-over-text (dense tokens overwhelm small LLM reasoning)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:313:  - **Long-sequence generation (any size)** → "**vision sink**" / cross-attention decay over time → text-over-vision drift
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:314:  - 这给 B0 (235B-A22B MoE + image embedding ~1.5K tokens) 跟 B1 (4B + 同 image budget) 一个不对称 mechanism prediction：B1 image-over-text dominance 更强；B0 long-trajectory text-over-vision drift 更强
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:315:- **SoM-specific harming channels formalized** (paper §5 axis 3 8-channel 的 cross-paper validation):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:316:  - **SoM occlusion → image-over-text (saliency hijack)** — markers obscure underlying pixels + act as "embedded geometric shape" distractor (与 §100 ground truth -60pp OCR 一致)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:317:  - **Numeric attention hijack at high mark density → text-over-vision (prior override)** — LLM 优化处理 alphanumeric, "latches onto numeric IDs as primary reasoning anchors" 离开 spatial grounding (与 §100 num_ids 0→446 一致)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:318:  - 注意 Q5 给两条 SoM channels 的 dominance direction 是 opposite — 这正是我们 axis 3 8-channel framework "bidirectional fusion" 的 lit anchor (一个 channel image-over-text，另一个同框架内反向 text-over-vision)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:319:- **Mid-layer attention decay (Liu 2025 "Devils in Middle Layers", arXiv:2512.07730)**: object hallucinations 是 multi-faceted — 同时由 mid-layer visual attention decay + decoding 时 language prior dominance 导致。**Paper §5 axis 3 双因机制 anchor** (从单 cause 升级到 dual cause 解释)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:320:- **Counter-evidence**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:321:  - "Seeing but Not Believing" (2025): linear probing 显示 visual encoder 准确提取 features，failure 是 **late-stage generative disconnect** 而非 cross-modal interaction failure → reviewer attack vector "你说 cross-modal failure 但其实是 decoding-stage failure"，paper §5 prose 应承认 mechanism granularity (我们的 8-channel 是 behavioral level, 不 commit on encoding vs decoding stage)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:322:  - M3amba (2025): 显式 bidirectional state space (BiMamba blocks) 在 specialized domain (pathology) 可 lossless integrate — 说明 bidirectional dominance 不是架构必然, 是 generalist VLM 的 typical pattern (paper §7 prose specialized exception caveat)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:323:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:324:→ **Paper §5 axis 3 prose strategy 升级**: 从 "我们 propose 8-channel" → "我们把 cross-paper 散落的 dominance findings 在 web-agent multi-step setting 系统映射成 8-channel + 提供 first systematic 分类". Bidirectional framing 是 Q5 "novel synthesis"，paper 在 web-agent 应用层是首次。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:325:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:326:### Zoom 3 counter-evidence catalog (NEW 2026-05-01 from Gemini DR, mandatory for paper §5 honest framing)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:327:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:328:**M1 (Image-mirage) counter-anchors** — text-only fallback fails on these:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:329:- **AsgardBench 2026**: text-only collapses on perception-conditioned execution tasks ("Text-Only performance remains low across models")
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:330:- **DailyDroid Benchmark 2026**: 75 tasks × 25 Android apps, multimodal > text-only on dynamic mobile GUI (margin "marginal" but consistent)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:331:- **Mind2Web Deep Research 2025**: text-only struggles with structurally ambiguous DOM environments + noisy spatial layouts
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:332:- **FileGramOS / Mind2Web Tracking 2025**: text-only insufficient for behavioral state tracking; rendered page images expose certain operational statistics
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:333:- → **Paper §1 hook honest framing**: text-only fallback works on **standard web schema with stable DOM**; fails on perception-conditioned, dynamic GUI, behavioral tracking, structurally ambiguous tasks
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:334:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:335:**M2 (Flat-list) counter-anchors** — flat-list framing is not universally superior:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:336:- **Tan 2026 HMT**: hierarchical 84.2% recall vs flat 65.8% (memory architecture context, not direct observation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:337:- "**Flat sequences actively remove critical structural signals** required for human-level spatial reasoning" — failed to indicate line wraps, grouping, spatial organization
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:338:- **Q2 surprise**: DOM-element-id referencing > SoM [N] referencing in some prompt-instruction settings — paper §2 prose must distinguish phantom-space P-text uses [SOM_MARKS] **obs format** (different from "SoM-style prompt referencing system" — these are independent dimensions in our 2x2 cube)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:339:- **Zheng et al. 2024 EMNLP** "When 'A Helpful Assistant' Is Not Really Helpful": 162 personas, **NO effect on accuracy** vs no-persona baseline — counter-evidence on persona-style prompt effects
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:340:- → **Paper §2 prose distinguish**: phantom space P-text is obs-format swap (axis 1), NOT prompt-instruction-style swap. Sclar/Mishra prompt-format sensitivity applies to former.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:341:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:342:**M3 (Image axis bidirectional dominance) counter-anchors** — bidirectional framing not universal (Q5 Gemini DR):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:343:- **"Seeing but Not Believing" 2025**: linear probing on visual encoder shows it accurately extracts features; failure is **late-stage generative disconnect inside LLM**, NOT cross-modal interaction failure. Implication: paper §5 axis 3 prose 不应 over-commit "cross-modal failure" mechanism — 我们 8-channel 是 behavioral level taxonomy, 不 claim encoding-stage vs decoding-stage attribution
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:344:- **M3amba 2025**: explicit BiMamba blocks 在 pathology (specialized domain) achieve lossless bidirectional integration — bidirectional dominance 不是架构必然, 是 generalist VLM 的 typical pattern. Paper §7 cross-domain caveat: 我们 finding 限于 generalist VLM (B0 Qwen3-VL-235B, B1 Qwen3-VL-4B), domain-specialized fine-tuned VLM 可能不复现
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:345:- **MM-Vet 7-capability decomposition**: failure mode is **task-dependent / both directions** — single dominance direction framing 可能 oversimplify. Paper §5 prose 应保持 "site-modulated" framing 跟 Q5 task-dependent 一致 (cls visual-rich → image-axis dominate; red text-dom → text-axis dominate)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:346:- → **Paper §5 axis 3 honest framing**: bidirectional fusion 是 behavioral-level pattern, 不 commit mechanism stage; site/task/capability modulate which direction dominates
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:347:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:348:**Capability-scaling (Lazy Minimization) counter-anchors** — small VLMs are not universally inferior:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:349:- **ChartGemma 3B** (early-fusion VLM fine-tuned for chart QA): 3B specialized model **beats GPT-4o**, on par with closed-source frontier VLMs — fine-tuning can override Lazy Minimization in narrow visual domains
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:350:- **InternVL3 8B**: under specific high-contrast marker conditions, **matches or exceeds Gemini 2.5 Pro** grounding accuracy (VPBench evaluation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:351:- **See&Trek**: spatial markers cause performance **drops** on Relative Direction and Object Counting tasks for some small VLMs — signal-priority hierarchy is not universally absolute
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:352:- → **Paper §7 prose framing**: Lazy Minimization is general trend for **standard generalist VLMs**, with domain-specialized fine-tuned exceptions
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:353:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:354:> **🆕 Paper §1 first-work claim verified (Q3 Gemini DR 2026-05-01)**: Gemini deep research synthesis explicitly confirms "no study isolates SoM-style flat text as a standalone observation without its accompanying marked screenshot" — Phantom-SoM paper §1 hook "first systematic SoM-text isolation" claim is lit-verified novel. Reviewer attack vector "you are not first" is preempted via Q3 forward-citation-chain analysis (FOCUSAGENT prunes hierarchy but doesn't compare to flat list; HMT compares hierarchical vs flat in memory architecture, not observation; Yang 2023 SoM original always bundles text with marked image).

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:356:### Zoom 4 (model-internal): Mechanistic probe lit anchors (paper §8 future work)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:357:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:358:**Paper 不 self-probe Zoom 4** (因 B0 proxy API 不暴露 router logits internals + local deploy Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 需 ~120GB VRAM 超 RunPod $200 budget). 但 lit anchors 给 mechanism plausibility:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:359:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:360:- **Cross-modal flow** (Kaduri et al.): layerwise attention probe 显示 middle-layer cross-modal flows enable image-like representations from query tokens — M1 axis activation 的 mechanistic 解释
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:361:- **SteerMoE expert routing** (Fayyaz et al. 2026 ICLR, 学长 2026-05-01 发, 详 §108.9): MoE LLM 用 paired prompts 算 expert Risk Difference, alignment 集中在 subset of experts, alternate routing path 可绕过 ("Alignment Faking")。**对 phantom-SoM 的暗示**: vision-grounding 在 VLM 也可能 concentrated in subset of experts, phantom routing 通过 obs/prompt config 绕过这些 experts。Methodology template for paper sequence follow-up paper (Phantom-SoM Zoom 1+2+3 + SteerMoE-style follow-up Zoom 4 self-probe = paper trilogy)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:362:- **Tool Calling Linear Steerable Circuit** (Anonymous 2026 ACL, 笔记 §19 archived 2026-04-09): 在 **Qwen3-4B** (跟 B1 = Qwen3-VL-4B 是 architectural cousin) 验证 — 15 tools → 10 PCA 方向 (90.2% var), **cosine gap 捕获 92% action-selection 错误**, L23+ layer steering 切 tool 准确率 80-93%, "**knows but cannot say**" (hidden state 77-89% correct, output layer 3-61%)。**对 phantom-SoM 的暗示**: (a) action selection 在 **action-type axis 线性可分** + argument generation 非线性，给 §1 cascade `DOM→P-text→P-SoM→SoM` 的 token-monotonic path 一个 mechanistic 理由 (轴 selection 比 argument 廉价); (b) hidden-state cosine gap 是 B1 白盒 routing signal candidate，AUROC 可对比 logprob (~2300 forward pass，无需重跑 environment); (c) "knows but cannot say" 跟我们 §70 infra 观测到 Bedrock proxy 静默吞 `tools`/`tool_choice` 参数返回纯文本的现象在不同 stack layer 互相印证 (架构层 vs API 层 stack-wide brittleness)。**对 B1-side 平衡 anchor**: SteerMoE / Cross-modal flow 都偏 B0 (235B-A22B MoE) 路径，Tool Calling Linear Circuit 是 Zoom 4 anchor stack 中**唯一在 4B 模型直接验证**的，给 paper §8 future work B1 self-probe 一个直接 method template (output_hidden_states=True forward pass + PCA + cosine gap AUROC, 仅 B1 白盒可行)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:363:

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:371:**B0 = Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 是 MoE family** (与 SteerMoE 实验 Qwen3-30B-A3B 是 architectural cousin), methodology 几乎可直接 transfer。**B1 = Qwen3-VL-4B** 跟 Tool Calling Linear Circuit 实验的 Qwen3-4B 是 architectural cousin (同 base LM, 加 vision encoder), tool selection 线性可分性合理 transfer 到 web action selection (click/type/scroll/finish 等 8 action 在结构上跟 ACL 论文 15 tools 同质)。两条 architectural cousin 路径让 follow-up paper 能 cover B0 + B1 双侧 mechanistic probe — 但本 paper 不 self-probe, 标 future work 列举。

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:394:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:395:### Axis 1: Text payload structure (PRIMARY, first-order SR effect)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:396:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:397:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:398:AXTree (hierarchical) vs [SOM_MARKS] (flat indexed) → action surface + trajectory basin
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:399:→ Phantom modes 获得 routing arm (因为 [SOM_MARKS] obs structure)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:400:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:401:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:402:注意：这个 axis 是 **text payload 结构**（agent 看到的 obs 文本），不是抽象的"模型表征"。Token 数大致不变（~3K both），但 layout / parsing pattern 不同。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:403:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:404:**LLM mechanism**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:405:- **Task ontology reframing — web-browsing → indexed selection** (核心 axis 1 effect, NEW 2026-05-01): AXTree (hierarchical tree, agent navigate tree structure 像 browser DOM walk) → `[SOM_MARKS]` (flat indexed list, agent picks ID 像 multiple-choice selection)。改变 LLM 任务 ontology 从 "browse the web" 到 "select from list"，trigger 不同的 in-context behavior。这是 P-text 4-mode drop-one +3.42-3.81pp 的根本机制。**Lit anchor**: deep research `docs/literature/The Novelty and Efficacy of Set-of-Mark Text...` line 84 frame 这个 split 为 "AXTree induces **tree traversal trajectory** (logical deduction over hierarchy) vs flat SoM induces **sequential list scanning trajectory** (rapid spatial approximation)"; paper draft `section2_background.md` line 27 已 adopt: "the flat marks list tends to shift exploration toward **quick element selection**, AXTree hierarchy supports **sustained navigation and search**". Sclar 2024 / Mishra 2022 prompt-format sensitivity theory 提供 transformer-level mechanism (different token distribution → distinct latent state → distinct exploration policy).
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:406:- Token distribution shift (hierarchical metadata vs flat indexed list)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:407:- In-context learning bias (pretraining data context — selection-style prompts have stronger few-shot examples in pretraining)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:408:- Long-context attention degradation (Liu 2023 "Lost in the Middle" — flat list 缓解 hierarchical mid-tree attention drop)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:409:- Output format priming (selection prompts produce shorter / more committed outputs)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:410:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:411:**Evidence**: fig3 strategy gradient (reddit verified §103 N=48, cls live extension), fig5 category × mode
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:412:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:413:### Axis 2: Prompt (multi-dimensional task-conditional decision prior)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:414:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:415:**Falsified hypothesis**: "prompt 只影响 commitment confidence" (codex `5821387` falsifies)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:416:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:417:**Replaced theory**: Prompt acts as task-conditional decision prior over:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:418:- (a) search phrasing
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:419:- (b) candidate selection (ranking/disambiguation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:420:- (c) backtracking strategy
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:421:- (d) commitment confidence (FP gap evidence, **subeffect not唯一**)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:422:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:423:**Visual prompting without image (P-prompt 的核心 LLM 机制, NEW 2026-05-01)**: SoM-style prompt 即使无 image 仍 activate agent 的 "visual-mark referencing" mental model —— prompt 期望 numerical-marker referencing system，agent 在 AXTree 上自动 fallback 到 element_id 引用，仍 recover **substantial fraction (~70-80%) of visual structure information from textual cues**。**Lit anchor stack (3 互补 mechanism)**: (a) **Mirage Effect** Asadi et al. 2026 (arXiv:2603.21687, Stanford) — VLM 无图时仍自信描述视觉特征，**无图准确率达有图的 70-80%** (mirage-mode > guess-mode), 实验笔记 §18 line 457; (b) **Scaffold Effect** Vu & Balloccu 2026 — prompt 仅提及 MRI 可用就解释 **70-80% 性能变化** independent of image presence (clinical VLM 起源, web agent 同样适用), 实验笔记 §25 + phantom_som.md line 281; (c) **Cross-modal flow** Kaduri et al. — middle-layer cross-modal flows enable VLMs to store image info in query tokens, allowing image-consistent generation without direct image-token attention (phantom_som.md §2.1 line 83-89). 即 axis 2 swap **不是** "prompt label 改"，而是 **task ontology 切换 from textual-action-prompt to visual-mark-referencing-prompt**。这与 axis 1 的 "browse → select" 形成对称 (axis 1 改 obs ontology，axis 2 改 action-referencing ontology)。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:424:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:425:**Empirically verified**: B0 red P-prompt 4-mode drop-one **+2.86pp [0.95, 5.24] sig** (axis 2 alone 在 AXTree 锚点下有 routing value)；6-mode vs 5-mode marginal lift +1.90pp sig 验证 P-prompt 贡献 incremental unique tasks。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:426:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:427:**Evidence**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:428:- P-text ∩ Phantom-SoM Jaccard 0.45-0.54 (task pool 显著 disjoint despite same SR)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:429:- 6 case studies (codex `5821387` phantom_dom_vs_som_diagnostic.md)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:430:- N=48 verified anchor: Phantom-SoM FP gap 2.08pp vs P-text 6.25pp
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:431:- B0 red P-prompt 4-mode drop-one +2.86pp sig (axis 2 alone @ AXTree 锚点 valid)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:432:- B0 red 6-mode oracle +7.14pp [3.81, 10.48] vs 3-mode (3 phantom arms 都贡献 unique tasks)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:433:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:434:**Lit support**: Persona priming (Salemi 2024), in-context learning (Min 2022), Sclar 2024 prompt format sensitivity, Mishra 2022. **Visual prompting without image / Mirage Effect** anchored on: Asadi et al. 2026 (arXiv:2603.21687) Mirage Effect (~70-80% of with-image accuracy); Vu & Balloccu 2026 Scaffold Effect (prompt mentioning modality alone explains 70-80% perf shift); Kaduri et al. cross-modal flow mechanistic explanation (image info stored in query tokens). 三个 mechanism stack 完整支撑 axis 2 alone routing value (B0 red P-prompt drop-one +2.86pp sig). Task-pool divergence Jaccard <0.5 是 paper unique empirical finding.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:435:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:436:### Axis 3: Image (8-channel multi-dimensional, codex `7106d2e` validated)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:437:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:438:**Falsified hypothesis**: "Visual-hijack 是唯一 image effect" (codex `7106d2e` falsifies)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:439:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:440:**Replaced theory**: Image is **bidirectional modality fusion** with multiple sub-channels:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:441:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:442:**Cross-paper lit anchor stack (Q5 Gemini DR 2026-05-01 evening)**: Bidirectional dominance framing 在 VLM general literature 是 "novel synthesis" (Q5 doc line 22), web-agent multi-step setting 是 paper §5 first systematic application。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:443:- **Dual-axis same-paper benchmarks**: Guan 2024 HallusionBench (CVPR) "visual illusion" + "language hallucination" 同 suite; Sun 2023 MMHal-Bench 8 categories 同 model; 实证 bidirectional dominance 是 measurable architecture property 不是 paper artifact
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:444:- **Per-axis benchmark mapping**: image-over-text → Li 2023 POPE (co-occurrence FP) + CHAIR (autoregressive fill); text-over-vision → Tong 2024 Eyes Wide Shut + Fu 2024 BLINK (perception primitives 24-30% near random) + Bitton-Guetta 2023 WHOOPS! + MM-Vet OCR/spatial fallback
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:445:- **Mid-layer mechanism dual-cause** (Liu 2025 "Devils in Middle Layers" arXiv:2512.07730): mid-layer visual attention decay + decoding-time language prior dominance — paper §5 axis 3 dual-cause anchor
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:446:

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:448:- 3a Spatial grounding (cls 5 tasks)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:449:- 3b Visual context disambiguation (cls 13 / red 2)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:450:- 3c Element disambiguation (cls 10)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:451:- 3d State/action recognition (cls 1 / red 6)

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:455:  - Mechanism: image-text alignment pretraining bias → premature commit
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:456:  - Lit: Li 2023 POPE (EMNLP, co-occurrence FP), Yang 2024, Yu 2024 (object hallucination); Guan 2024 HallusionBench dual-axis benchmark "visual illusion" axis (Q5)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:457:- **3f Text-over-vision fallback fail** (反向 modality bias) [cls task 24 verified]
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:458:  - Mechanism: language prior dominance → ignore actual image content
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:459:  - Lit: ⭐ Tong 2024 "Eyes wide shut" (CVPR), Bitton-Guetta 2023 WHOOPS! (ICCV); Fu 2024 BLINK (ECCV, perception primitives 24-30%); Liu 2025 Devils mid-layer attention decay; Guan 2024 HallusionBench "language hallucination" axis (Q5)

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:461:  - 实测: 15× cycles same image link, element_id +2846 each cycle (page reload 不脱)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:462:  - 与 SoM density 不直接相关 (mark_count 117 ≠ outlier vs P95 127)

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:464:  - 量化: B0/B1 reddit_task_6 mode-SoM 18%/15% vs NoMarks 78%/75% → **-60pp OCR**
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:465:  - Lit (Q5): Q5 doc formalizes SoM occlusion → image-over-text (saliency hijack) — markers obscure pixels + "embedded geometric shape" distractor
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:466:- **3i SoM numeric label attention hijack** [§100 verified, density-dependent]
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:467:  - 量化: B1 num_ids 0→**446** at 128 marks; mode-WithText 立即降 0
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:468:  - Lit (Q5): Q5 doc formalizes numeric hijack → text-over-vision (prior override) — LLM optimized for alphanumeric "latches onto numeric IDs as primary reasoning anchors"; opposite dominance direction vs 3h, 验证 axis 3 同 framework 内 bidirectional

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:576:### Paper contribution position (Section 5 framing)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:577:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:578:**不是发现新 LLM mechanism** (每 axis 都有 prior literature). Contribution 是:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:579:1. **Systematic isolation** (2x2 ablation matrix)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:580:2. **Joint quantification** (Jaccard 0.33-0.55 disjoint task pools)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:581:3. **Site-modulated framework** (cls vs red natural ablation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:582:4. **Drop-in deployment claim** (4-fold drop-in property)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:583:5. **Paper-grade clean re-run protocol** (watchdog auto-clean + 重跑 verify)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:584:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:585:→ Section 5 prose 应当 frame 成 "we don't propose new LLM mechanisms; we systematically decompose them in web-agent multi-step setting + provide drop-in deployment evidence".

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:603:## §3 Findings — 4-dimension Evidence + Mechanism Framework (重组 2026-04-29, 2026-05-01 update: evidence/explanation separation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:604:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:605:> **Cross-reference (added 2026-05-04)**: §3 是 **paper finding evidence layer** (4 测量 × 4 cross-X = 16 sub-cells); 跟 §21 **intervention taxonomy** (~40 笔记 § environmental work) 是 orthogonal — §3 关心 phantom routing space 的 SR/cost/AUROC 实证, §21 关心 paper 周边 environmental scaffolding work 的 substrate categorization. **环境侧 fix** (§51-62 / §80 / §107 等 9 条) 是 §21 的 (i)+(ii)×L2 cell 内容, **paper §3 evaluation methodology footnote** acknowledge 这些 fix (跟 Avenir Web ignore env issue 形成 rigor differentiator), 但 detail 不在 §3 主分析。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:606:>
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:607:> **重组动因 (§105)**：之前 10 条 finding 是 flat list，paper 写作时不好定位"哪个证据支持哪个 claim"。重组为 **4-dimension framework** —— 每个证据进对应 dimension，每个 paper claim 引用 dimension (e.g. "Outcome 0d Jaccard 0.447 supports routing-arm complementarity")。四个 dimensions 是 **正交** 的（不是 hierarchical layers）。**所有原 10 条 finding 都映射到对应 dimension，未删除**（见末尾索引）。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:608:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:609:### Evidence vs Explanation Layer Separation (2026-05-01 update)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:610:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:611:Paper conceptual structure 严格 2 层分离 (避免 evidence-as-explanation 混淆):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:612:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:613:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:614:EVIDENCE LAYER (观测数据, 2D organize: 测量类型 × 比较 axis)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:615:   测量类型 (4 dim)          ×    比较 axis (4 cross-X)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:616:   ─────────────────              ─────────────────────
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:617:   Outcome (SR/oracle/Jaccard)   cross-task   (within-cell aggregation, 统计 foundation)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:618:   Macro   (action 频率)         cross-mode⭐ (phantom space 主战场, paired)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:619:   Micro   (per-step 决策)       cross-site   (跨 web 环境 generalization)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:620:   Efficiency (cost/lat/carbon)  cross-model  (跨 capability generalization)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:621:   
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:622:   = 4 × 4 = 16 evidence sub-cells (cross-mode 那列最 saturated, 是 §3 sub-codes 0a-3d 主居)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:623:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:624:EXPLANATION LAYER (因果假说, 1D organize: zoom scale)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:625:   Zoom 1 (coarsest, 架构):   Approach 2 = "phantom space 内 M1/M2 axes by design exhaustive"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:626:                              (§2 Theory Framework 主用, deductive)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:627:   Zoom 2 (中粗, behavioral):  "M1 produces Image-mirage activation, M2 produces list-scanning"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:628:                              (§5 Mechanism prose 主用, inductive 用 Macro/Micro evidence)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:629:   Zoom 3 (中细, named):       Mirage Effect (Asadi 2026) / Scaffold Effect (Vu Balloccu 2026) /
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:630:                              prompt-format sensitivity (Sclar 2024)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:631:                              (§5 lit anchor cite, cross-model phenomenon names)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:632:   Zoom 4 (最深, internal):    Cross-modal flow (Kaduri) / SteerMoE expert routing (Fayyaz 2026)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:633:                              (§8 future work 标 lit anchor, paper 不 self-probe)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:634:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:635:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:636:**关键区分**: §3 4-dim 是 evidence layer 的**测量类型轴**, cross-X 是 evidence layer 的**比较 axis 轴**。两者**正交 organize 同一份数据**。Explanation layer 跟 evidence layer 严格分开 — explanation 是 hypothesis (Zoom 1-4), evidence 是 data。Paper writing 时 reviewer 最忌 evidence-explanation 混淆 ("Macro 1c search-loop 51.9→35.7%" 是 evidence, "M1 axis activates list-scanning trajectory" 是 explanation Zoom 2 — 两者必须分写然后 explicit link)。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:637:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:638:### Cross-X 比较 axis (4 类) 的 paper section mapping
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:639:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:640:| Cross-X | 固定 keys | 变 key | Paper section 用 | Saturation status (2026-05-01) |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:641:|---|---|---|---|---|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:642:| **cross-task** | mode + site + model | task | §3/§4 evidence aggregation 基础 | ✅ 234 cls / 210 reddit per cell |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:643:| **cross-mode** ⭐ | task + site + model | mode (4 phantom + 2 image-on/only) | §4/§5 phantom space 主分析 | 🟡 B0 cls/red 5-mode done, B1 phantom 跑中, shop missing |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:644:| **cross-site** | task + mode + model | site (cls/red/shop/WA) | §7 generalization | 🔴 B0 5-mode shop missing, WA 全 missing |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:645:| **cross-model** | task + mode + site | model (B0/B1/Claude) | §7 cross-capability | 🔴 cross-model 数据稀薄, B1 phantom 跑中, Claude 0 |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:646:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:647:**Paper §7 (generalization) 当前 ~40% 因为 cross-site + cross-model 两 axis 数据稀薄**, 不是 §7 prose 写作问题 — 是 cross-X saturation 不够。16-cell rerun 后 cross-mode + cross-model partially fill, 但 cross-site 仍需 shop + WA 数据 (Tier 2 expansion)。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:648:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:649:### 4-dimension framework 概览
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:650:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:651:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:652:Outcome     哪些 task 成功 / 哪些 mode 在哪些 task 上 win

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:734:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:735:### Mechanism chain — 三个机制阶段
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:736:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:737:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:738:Stage 1 (Outcome 层):    P-SoM 的 routing arm 价值在 task-pool complementarity (0d), 不在 aggregate SR
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:739:                         ↓ 为什么 P-SoM 拿到 unique tasks?
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:740:Stage 2 (Micro 层):       因为 axis 1+2 swap 改变了 per-step 决策 (2a 0.48-0.66 URL Jaccard)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:741:                          ↓ 这些决策具体改了什么?
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:742:Stage 3 (Mechanism 层):  axis 1 改 text payload 结构 → 改 in-context attention pattern → 改 element selection 决策
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:743:                          axis 2 改 prompt 描述 → 改 task-conditional decision prior → 改 commit / search / 导航策略
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:744:                          axis 3 加 image → 改 visual disambiguation → 决定 cls 上的 finish rate
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:745:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:746:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:747:**关键 insight**: Macro dimension (action-type 频率) 是 downstream signal，单独看会误导 (cls case)。真正的 mechanism chain 是 Micro dimension (decision quality) + Outcome dimension (task-pool complementarity) 闭环。

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:751:### Honest framing (avoid over-claim)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:752:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:753:- Phantom-SoM red **adj 13.81% > SoM adj 10.48%** —— 这次有数据，是 site-specific dominance（reddit 上）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:754:- cls SoM **adj 21.37% 显著领先 P-SoM 14.53% (+6.84pp)** —— 反例必须明示, image 在 cls 是决定性 axis (Macro 1b 5/8 dominant 印证)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:755:- 主 narrative: **site-modulated representation × prompt × image effects**, 不是 "Phantom #1 universal routing arm"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:756:- Macro dimension 单独 weak on cls (1/8 fully independent) —— paper 必须用 Outcome task-pool + Micro 一起讲，不能只 cite macro
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:757:- §103 N=48 "5/5 metrics P-text = P-SoM" 已 **superseded** by N=210 (FRESH 04-29 Macro 1c) — 早期 small-sample artifact

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:789:---
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:790:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:791:### Evidence vs Explanation: framework 的真实定位（2026-04-29 反思）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:792:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:793:4-dimension framework **不是 paper Section 4/5 的 narrative 结构**，是**分析 scaffold + future-data drop-in 索引**。明确两个层次：
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:794:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:795:#### 4-dimension = Evidence dimensions（paper Section 4）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:796:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:797:观测 evidence: "在 mode/axis swap 下我们 observe 到什么 shift"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:798:- Outcome: 哪些 task 成功（SR / oracle / Jaccard / category / overlap / AUROC）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:799:- Macro: agent 平均怎么 act（action-type 频率 cascade）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:800:- Micro: per-step 决策怎么变（URL / target / keyword）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:801:- Efficiency: 资源 footprint（cost / latency / carbon）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:802:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:803:四个 **正交 dimensions**（不是 hierarchical layers），从宏观 outcome 到微观 decision。Paper Section 4 是 evidence catalog，每个 sub-finding 引用一个 dimension 的数据 + figure。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:804:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:805:#### LLM mechanism = Explanation layer（paper Section 5）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:806:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:807:解释 evidence: "为什么 axis swap 产生这个 shift"——必须 **跨 dimension** 同时 **site × axis × LLM-mechanism** 三阶交互：
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:808:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:809:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:810:观测 (evidence): reddit axis 1 swap → search-loop 51.9 → 35.7 (Macro 1c) +
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:811:                                       URL Jaccard 0.57 (Micro 2a) +
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:812:                                       SR uplift 4.76pp drop-one (Outcome 0c)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:813:解释 (LLM mechanism):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:814:  AXTree (hierarchical, sidebar embedded in tree) → [SOM_MARKS] (flat indexed list)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:815:  ⇒ attention pattern shift: sidebar forum link 在 flat list 显著
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:816:  ⇒ agent 直接 click forum link 而非 search-loop
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:817:  ⇒ trajectory 变短 + 决策准 + SR up
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:818:  ⇒ 横跨 Macro+Micro+Outcome dimensions 的 single mechanism
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:819:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:820:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:821:不同 site 触发不同 mechanism (site × axis × LLM):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:822:- **reddit text-heavy forum**: axis 1 主要影响 attention pattern (sidebar visibility)；image axis 几乎冗余
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:823:- **cls visual-rich product browsing**: axis 3 image 是 affordance（finish-rate h=+0.57 决定性）；axis 1 主要影响 ID-system parsing efficiency
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:824:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:825:**paper Section 5 narrative 由 mechanism 驱动**, dimension-organized evidence 作 underlying support — 不是按 dimension 组织 narrative。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:826:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:827:#### Axis decomposition（diamond 完整后的 final form）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:828:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:829:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:830:total observed effect (DOM → SoM endpoint)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:831:  = main(axis 1, P-text alone via DOM↔P-text)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:832:  + main(axis 2, P-prompt alone via DOM↔P-prompt)              [DIAMOND ENABLES]
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:833:  + main(axis 3, image alone via P-SoM↔SoM)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:834:  + interaction(axis 1, axis 2)                                 [DIAMOND ENABLES]
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:835:  + ...higher-order interactions usually 0
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:836:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:837:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:838:P-prompt 是必需的，因为它是 **axis 2 在 AXTree-text context 下的唯一测量点**。如果 interaction term ≈ 0 → paper 写 "axis additive, independent first-order"；如果 interaction term ≠ 0 → honest disclose "axis 1 effect is modulated by prompt context"。任一 verdict 都比 cascade-only 多一个 quantitative claim。

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:855:#### Caveats / honest framing
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:856:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:857:- **N=234 cls underpower**: cls Macro dimension 弱信号可能是 statistical power not enough（needs ~800 task to detect d=0.2 small effect with α=0.05, β=0.2）。后续 shopping 466 + WA 480 数据可补强
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:858:- **命名约定**: paper-facing 用 "Outcome / Macro / Micro / Efficiency" (4 orthogonal dimensions). Sub-codes (0a / 1c / 2a / 3d) 保留作 figure-internal anchors. Code-level CLI 保留 "layered_*" 别名 (Makefile target / `layered_status.py` / `layered_evidence_status.md`) 作 backward compat
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:859:- **不是所有 13 figures 进 paper**：Section 4 只 cherry-pick 5 个代表 figure (e.g. fig0c + fig0d + fig0g + fig1c + fig3d)，其他 supplementary
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:860:- **paper Section 5 可能简化**：若 codex prose 过分 dimension cataloging，必须 mechanism-first restructure

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:881:#### Tier 2 — Mechanistic interpretability (B1-only, executes 实验笔记 §19 future-work)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:882:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:883:实验笔记 §19 已 documented "Tool Calling is a Linear, Steerable Circuit" (ACL 2026, Qwen3 4B verified) 适用于 P79: action selection 是线性电路, cosine gap 预测 92% 错误, L23+ steering 可 80-93% 准确率切换 tool。Section 5 paper-strongest mechanism evidence 走这条路:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:884:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:885:| Metric | What it measures | Tooling | Status |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:886:|---|---|---|---|
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:887:| **M1** B1 attention pattern probe | feed same task obs through B1 in DOM/P-text/P-SoM modes; extract attention to "forum sidebar link" / "search box" / "post title" tokens; measure shift across modes | `output_attentions=True` forward pass, ~2300 forwards | 🟡 blocked B1 GPU contention |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:888:| **M2** B1 hidden state probing | layer L hidden state → probe "task will succeed"; PCA cosine gap (per §19) → AUROC vs logprob | `output_hidden_states=True` forward pass; PCA + LR | 🟡 blocked B1 GPU |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:889:| **M3** Token-level decision attribution | next-action token distribution per mode; quantify "axis 1 改 token-level decision prior" claim | forward inference, no training | 🟡 blocked B1 GPU |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:890:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:891:**Trigger condition**: B1 GPU 空 (~B1 phantom 4-cell chain done, ~30-40d ETA). 不需要重跑 environment — `~2300 task × ~12 steps = ~28K forward passes`, 离线 inference 单 GPU 可在 ~1-2 天 batch 跑完。Code 已部分存在: `analyze_confidence_calibration.py` 处理 logprob, 可扩展 `output_hidden_states/attentions` 提取。
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:892:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:893:**Paper value**: 比 Tier 1 行为分析更 mechanistic, reviewer 期望顶刊看到。直接对应 ACL 2026 Tool Calling lit。

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:900:| **H2** Steering vectors | train PCA / linear probe to find "mode direction" in activation space; add steering vector at inference to induce mode-like behavior without obs/prompt swap | per §19 future work "L23 steering 修正 'know-but-cant-say'" | 🔴 blocked B1 GPU + advanced technique |
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:901:| **H3** Attention head ablation | systematic zero-out specific heads; find "axis 1 head" / "axis 2 head" responsible for mode-specific behavior | head-by-head intervention scaffold | 🔴 heaviest, possible split paper |

docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1038:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1039:- **R1 落地 = paper 几乎稳进顶刊** (NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML 中位 60% level + cascade 99%). 旧 §5 写的"NeurIPS 45-60%"是 R3 baseline, 现在 R1 提到 55-70%.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1040:- **R3 是旧 §5 的隐含基线** — 假设 hero 过但 structural 没专门测, 退回 04-30 旧 framing "Phantom-SoM is hidden 4th routing arm". 现在概率没变 (因为旧 §5 写的就是这个 case).
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1041:- **R4 是真危险区** — MLSys + TMLR 仍能保底, 但 top-tier <30%. 这就是为啥 16-cell rerun (cost/latency 重测) 必跑.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1042:- **R5 概率低但要 acknowledge** — pivot 路径有 (VWA bug paper 已经是独立 short paper 候选).
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1043:- **Cascade 投稿策略**: NeurIPS → ACL/EMNLP → MLSys → TMLR, R1/R2/R3 都能在 ≤2 轮 cascade 内 land.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1044:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1045:#### 数据未确认前的实际期待 (advisor sync 用)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1046:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1047:5/5 sync 时跟学长讲实际期待: **R2 是合理 baseline expectation** (R1 over-optimistic, R3 conservative). R2 conditional cascade ~97%, top-tier 中位 50-55%. 16-cell rerun 后可以 update 到 actual R-rule branch.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1048:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1049:#### Caveats (-)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1050:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1051:- **Cross-family generalization**: Single backbone (Qwen3-VL) 即使跟 Magma/ScribeAgent same base, reviewer 仍可能要 Claude Opus cls+red 12 cells (`paper_planning §16` advisor-input). 如果延期 → 全条目 -1-2%.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1052:- **VWA only**: Mind2Web 2 (newer benchmark) reviewer 可能挑. Marginal -1%.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1053:- **Early-stop choice**: Option A (full cancel) → 数据全 dim clean; B/C → paper §4 disclosure overhead, -1-2%.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1054:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1055:### Multi-metric + Green AI axis 加成的 paper-level 价值
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1056:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1057:1. **Differentiator**: 现 web-agent paper (VWA/WebArena/SeeAct/SoM/FocusAgent) 几乎全不报 carbon
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1058:2. **Multi-metric Pareto** 在 ML 顶会近年是 expected
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1059:3. **三向 drop-in** (cost+latency+carbon) narrative 立体
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1060:4. **Green AI** 是顶会新兴 axis (Strubell ACL 2019, Patterson 2021)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1061:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1062:**Caveat**: green AI 是 second-order, 不能抢主线 "hidden routing arm + drop-in deployment"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1063:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1064:---
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1065:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1066:## §6 Critical Risks + Mitigation (4 risks, 决定接收 vs reject)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1067:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1068:### Risk 1: Execution quality（顶刊成败 #1 因素 ⚠️⚠️⚠️）
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1069:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1070:90 cells × ~1390 task = ~125K episode. 任何 cell 跑 sloppy (auth bug / cross-contam / 数据污染 / FP 没处理) 都被 reviewer 抓出.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1071:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1072:**Mitigation**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1073:- 维持 paper-grade re-run 协议: reset between conditions, exclusive same-site B0 XOR B1, watchdog auto-rederive
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1074:- 每 cell 完成后立刻 `make analyze` + manual audit gallery
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1075:- **不在 execution quality 妥协**
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1076:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1077:**Status (04-28)**: ✅ B0 cls + red 5-mode 100% paper-grade clean (watchdog auto-clean verified, 0% wasted task)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1078:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1079:**Update (2026-05-06 evening)**: ⭐ **UCL Condense A100 dedicated allocated** by Steve (admin) — 笔记 §112. 80GB VRAM, B1 Qwen3-VL-4B bf16 ~10GB → 8× headroom, cell-parallel feasible. 16-cell rerun timeline: DGX shared ~3 周 → A100 ~3-5 d. Mechanistic Stage 2B curated scale-up + Llama-4 cross-arch 现 exam 期间 (5/12-6/1) parallel 跑. Pending Steve SSH info / dashboard node show; verify 通过后 flip Tier 0 primary, demote 5090/Rancher/RunPod 到 redundancy.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1080:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1081:### Risk 2: Story discipline ⚠️⚠️
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1082:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1083:6×3×5 cells 容易让 paper 变 "data dump". 顶会 reviewer 反感 "everything but the kitchen sink".
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1084:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1085:**Single narrative**: "Phantom-SoM is hidden routing arm + we explain why + we route on it + here's the cost saving".
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1086:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1087:其他 finding (capability shift / category profile) 都是 supporting evidence. Section 4-5 each ≤4 pages, supplementary 装其余.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1088:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1089:### Risk 3: Router design ⚠️⚠️
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1090:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1091:Router 只比 best-single-mode 提升 1-2pp 被 reviewer 说 "不值". Oracle features (test-time leak) 直接 reject.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1092:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1093:**Router design tiers**:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1094:- **Tier 1 (must-have)**: Oracle router — task feature → best mode lookup, train/test split
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1095:- **Tier 2 (great-to-have)**: First-step-trigger router — 看 step 1 obs 决定 mode, no test leak
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1096:- **Tier 3 (stretch)**: Online learning router — mid-trajectory escalation
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1097:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1098:Tier 1 + Tier 2 就够顶会 contribution; Tier 3 stretch goal.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1099:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1100:**Realistic timeline**: ~3-4 周 (vs 之前估 2-3 周)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1101:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1102:**Minimum viable router** (start ~3 天 prototype):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1103:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1104:Feature:  task instruction TF-IDF + binary {has_ref_image, has_finish_string_match}
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1105:Target:   max adjusted SR
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1106:Model:    Logistic regression (interpretable + small-data friendly)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1107:Train:    cls + red 6 mode, 80/20 split
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1108:Baseline: random / best-single-mode / rule-based ("if has_ref_image → SoM else → Phantom-SoM")
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1109:```
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1110:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1111:### Risk 4: Negative results 必须诚实报告 ⚠️
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1112:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1113:某些 cell 可能反 trend (e.g. Claude shopping Phantom-SoM 不 work). **绝不 cherry-pick**, reviewer 看出直接 reject.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1114:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1115:**Mitigation**: 诚实报告反而强化 mechanism claim ("effect 是 task-type/capability bound, 不是 universal").
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1116:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1117:### Risk 5: B0 vs B1 reproducibility 不对称 (新增 2026-04-30) ⚠️
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1118:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1119:**实证 finding** (probe_b37_api_determinism.py 5 calls × T=0+top_p=1.0 + seed=42 forwarded):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1120:- B1 (4B local + `do_sample=False` + `torch.manual_seed`): byte-deterministic by construction
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1121:- **B0 (235B proxy API): 5/5 calls produced 5 distinct byte-level outputs** at T=0
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1122:- BUT: 5/5 calls selected the **same action** (`click element_id=5`) — decision-level convergent
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1123:- Output token count varied 38/45/46/49/49 — model genuinely sampling differently across calls
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1124:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1125:**Reviewer attack vector**: "你 paper 说 seed=42 reproducible, 但 B0 proxy 不可控, 你 SR 数字哪有 reproducibility?"
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1126:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1127:**Mitigation** (Section 4 disclosure):
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1128:1. Frame B0 vs B1 asymmetry honestly: B1 strict deterministic; B0 decision-level convergent only
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1129:2. SR-level conclusions robust (action selection stable across replicates)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1130:3. Token-level metrics (string_match exact-match, thought-text similarity) acknowledged residual variance
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1131:4. Empirical evidence anchored in `docs/analysis/cross_sites/probe_b37_api_determinism.md` (5 raw outputs + Section 4 disclosure paragraph drafted)
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1132:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1133:**Cost saved by NOT pursuing this further**: replication study at full 16-cell scale would cost ~$60-200; instead cheap 5-call probe ($0.005) gave us decisive characterization. Paper Section 4 disclosure paragraph is the deliverable.
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1134:
docs/checkpoints/paper_planning.md:1135:---
